queries.query: large language model OR LLM "network configuration" OR "network configurations" "intent to configuration" "intent-to-config"
queries.rationale: Directly target literature on LLMs translating operator intent or natural language into device/router configurations (phenomenon: intent→config).
source_preferences: vendor whitepapers (Cisco, Juniper) for applied examples

queries.query: "generate-validate-repair" OR "generate validate repair" OR "generate-and-validate" "network configuration" LLM verifier
queries.rationale: Search for architectures that pair generation with validators/repair loops (mechanisms and mitigations: generate–validate–repair).

queries.query: LLM hallucination network operations "unsafe configuration" "incorrect command" "misconfiguration"
queries.rationale: Find empirical reports and analyses of LLM failure modes specific to NetOps (phenomenon: hallucination→unsafe/misconfig).

queries.query: "formal verification" "network configuration" "header space analysis" "reachability" verification tools
queries.rationale: Locate established deterministic validators and formal methods for config correctness to use as validators/benchmarks (benchmark validity & methods).
source_preferences: IEEE Transactions on Network and Service Management

queries.query: LLM tool use agentic "tool-augmented" "orchestrator" "agentic workflow" network operations
queries.rationale: Survey agentic and tool-using LLM designs that orchestrate multi-step NetOps workflows (mechanisms; orchestration risks/mitigations).
Map existing benchmarks and datasets for NetOps/ AIOps to evaluate benchmark validity, coverage gaps, and reproducibility.
Identify execution and emulation platforms used to validate generated configurations (methods for operational evaluation).

queries.query: "constrained generation" "schema" "template" "policy constraints" network config LLM safety
queries.rationale: Search for constrained-generation approaches (templates, schemas, guardrails) applicable to reducing unsafe NetOps outputs (mitigations).
Find work on LLM self-checking or iterative repair (mechanisms for bounded self-correction and reliability).

queries.query: human-in-the-loop NetOps "operator approval" "review workflow" LLM generated config
queries.rationale: Locate studies and operational designs that integrate human oversight into LLM-generated NetOps workflows (mitigations & operational trustworthiness).
source_preferences: IEEE/ACM conferences on human-computer interaction and operational systems

queries.rationale: Search for metrics and validation criteria that map LLM outputs to operational correctness (benchmark validity: what to measure).

queries.query: adversarial attacks LLM "prompt injection" "malicious config" network operations security
queries.rationale: Survey security threats specific to LLM-driven NetOps, including adversarial inputs and injection risks (threats & mitigations).
source_preferences: security conferences (USENIX Security, CCS, IEEE S&P)

queries.rationale: Cover neighbouring work where LLMs assist in diagnosis and remediation (adjacent NetOps tasks and methods).
source_preferences: industrial case studies and tool whitepapers

queries.query: datasets "router configurations" "Cisco IOS" "Juniper" "network config corpus" public dataset
queries.rationale: Find corpora of real/sanitized device configurations for training/evaluation and to check dataset representativeness (benchmark/data validity).

queries.query: evaluation methodology "LLM generated code" correctness "oracle validator" "test harness"
queries.rationale: General evaluation methods for generated code/configs: oracle validators, test harnesses, paired designs, and statistical approaches (methods & analysis design).
source_preferences: SE/PL conferences (ICSE, FSE) for code-generation evaluation

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed papers (conference/journal) and arXiv preprints with full text and bibliographic metadata
Primary-source descriptions of methods, datasets, or evaluation pipelines (not second-hand summaries)
Public datasets, code repositories, and tool documentation with clear provenance/license
Works addressing LLM/generative models applied to NetOps tasks or general LLM safety/verification methods applicable to NetOps
Foundational verification/formal-methods literature for network configurations (even if older) when directly relevant to validators
exclusion_criteria: Anecdotal blog posts or opinion pieces without reproducible method details, except for vendor or incident reports used as operational examples
Non-English sources unless authoritative translation/metadata available
Paywalled works inaccessible for verification (flag and attempt access; include only if primary evidence is obtainable)
Papers that only benchmark generic networking knowledge (QA) without operational config/validation relevance, unless useful for positioning
Duplicate workshop drafts superseded by a peer-reviewed version (prefer the final authoritative version)
date_rationale: Cover foundational verification and networking methods from their origin (e.g., early 2000s) through the present, with emphasis on 2019–2026 for LLM and agentic-AI advances. This ensures inclusion of seminal validators (older) and recent LLM/tool-use research (recent years).
